replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged idle native-delivery hold reads change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in idle native-delivery hold reads; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Codex/OpenCode drivers obtain delivery control on mail arrival and stop idle delivery-hold polling. Pending mail and predecessor hold adoption retain the three-second permit and one-second renewal. Idle is ready with a closed permission gate; failed control reads remain unavailable, and deliberate graph holds still block handoff.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by idle native-delivery hold reads; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by idle native-delivery hold reads.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
